text: dsh-rea-toggle 是一款面向 DSH Web 客户端的 REA MCP 开关。在对话输入框旁显示状态按钮，通过宿主 Web 端点读取状态并切换 REA 对应配置行的 disabled 标志。用户可查看 REA 当前是否启用，并在需要时开关服务；工具集合在 DSH 下次启动后更新。适合需要按场景启用或停用 REA MCP 工具的 DSH 用户。需要预先配置可启动 REA 的 MCP 行。

dsh-rea-toggle adds a REA MCP switch beside the DSH Web conversation composer. It reads REA status and toggles the disabled flag on the matching profile configuration row through host Web endpoints. The tool set updates after DSH restarts. Users need an existing REA MCP row.
想在 DSH 里快速开关 REA MCP 工具。
能不能在对话界面查看 REA 当前是否启用？
让 DSH 的输入框旁边出现 REA 状态开关。

How can I see whether REA tools are enabled in DSH?
REA 状态按钮：在对话输入框旁显示 REA 开启、关闭或状态未知；点击按钮可请求切换。
启用状态切换：按钮向宿主端点发送目标状态，宿主更新 profile 配置中匹配行的 disabled 标志；修改后需重启 DSH 才会改变工具集合。
状态查询：界面加载时读取宿主端点，显示 REA 当前状态；请求失败时展示错误状态和提示。
dsh-rea-toggle 会把目标 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 中对应 REA 行的 disabled 标志写入磁盘；开关变更后需要重启 DSH，工具集合才会更新。

dsh-rea-toggle README · 问题：[REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea) 会在宿主上注册 **229 个工具**（`mcp__rea__*`）。工具定义属于每次请求的系统提示，不管你调不调它。

实测数据（`rea-agents@6.8.0`，取服务器自己 `tools/list` 的返回）：

| 测量项 | 数值 |
|---|---|
| `tools/list` 返回的工具数 | 229 |
| 工具 `name` + `description` 总字符 | 139,502 |
| 粗略 token 估算（`字符 ÷ 3.5`） | **≈ 40,000 token** |

这只是**描述文本**，完整 JSON Schema 还要更多 —— 其中一部分已经被 REA 自己的 `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=compact` 压过了。不同 tokenizer、宿主版本、schema profile 会让数字浮动，量级不会变。

做逆向时，4 万 token 的工具面很划算。写个视频脚本时，这就是关不掉的死重。

dsh-rea-toggle README · 为什么 REA 自己不提供这个开关：对着 `rea-agents@6.8.0` 实测：

```console
$ rea mcp --help
rea mcp — Register as MCP server

Commands:

只有 `add` 和 `doctor`。**没有 `remove`、没有 `disable`、没有 enable、没有工具过滤。** `rea mcp add --agent <claude-code|cursor|…>` 干的事只是往某个客户端配置里**写一行**；REA 内部任何东西都无法在运行时注销自己的工具。

这是结构性的，不是疏漏：**MCP 服务器无法注销自己。** 工具之所以存在，是宿主启动了它并要了 `tools/list`。只有宿主能决定不要。

而宿主侧的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 也没有包含性过滤字段：

dsh-rea-toggle README · 它做什么：它翻的是**一个键** —— `disabled`，作用在 profile patch 的**一行**上：

```yaml

dsh-rea-toggle README · <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: rea-mcp
      disabled: true          # ← 只动这个
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config: { … }
```

- 除该文件外不读别的，写也只在那个标志位。
- 不碰 `~/.dsh/plugins/rea-agents`，不卸载 REA，不改任何二进制。
- 再点一下即还原。

dsh-rea-toggle README · 这个插件不是什么：- 不是 REA 的包装、分支或补丁。它从不读 REA 的代码或版本。
- 不是工具过滤器。`dsh-mcp-client` 没有包含性字段，所以"只留 20 个常用工具"在这里做不到 —— 要么 229 个，要么 0 个。
- 不是安装器。它不会去下 REA、Ghidra、JDK、adb 或 JADX。
- 不是安全绕过。它翻的是你自己本来就拥有的一个 YAML 键。
- 不是 token 计数器。≈4 万这个数字是从 REA 自己的 `tools/list` 估的，你在意就自己量。

dsh-rea-toggle README · 安全：两个端点只接受 `GET /status` 和 `POST /set`，只监听宿主自己的回环 Web 端口，`POST` 的 `Origin` 主机与请求 `Host` 不一致直接 403，body 上限 64 KiB。不向网络暴露任何东西。

插件只写一个路径 —— `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` —— 且只写目标行里的 `disabled` 那一行。

dsh-rea-toggle README · 排错：| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 输入框旁没有开关 | client 半在启动时没被扫描到 | 完全退出宿主（含托盘）再开 |
| 显示 `REA ?` | 端点不通或找不到目标行 | 悬停看提示；查 `/rea-toggle/status` |
| `row "rea-mcp" not found` | 你的 REA 行 id 不同 | 设 `config.targetId` |
| 关了之后工具还在 | 工具注册发生在启动时 | 重启宿主 |
| 改 `disabled` 没反应 | 这个 profile 里没有拉起 REA 的 `mcp-client` 行 | 那不是开关的问题，先查 REA 安装 |

dsh-rea-toggle README · dsh-rea-toggle：**English** · [简体中文](README.md) **A GUI switch for the REA MCP server in DeepSeek Harness.** Turn its ~229 `mcp__rea__*` tools on when you are reverse-engineering, and off when you are not — without editing YAML, and without paying their context cost in every unrelated conversation.

``` ● REA ON ← 229 tools registered, schemas ride along on every request ● REA OFF ← nothing registered, unrelated chats pay nothing ```

dsh-rea-toggle README · dsh-rea-toggle：


REA ON — all 229 mcp__rea__* tools are registered and ride along on every request


REA OFF — nothing is registered, unrelated chats pay nothing

---

dsh-rea-toggle README · The problem：[REA](https://github.com/morluto/rea) registers **229 tools** on the host (`mcp__rea__*`). Tool definitions are part of every request's system prompt, whether or not you call one.

Measured on `rea-agents@6.8.0`, using the server's own `tools/list` response:

| Measurement | Value |
|---|---|
| tools returned by `tools/list` | 229 |
| total characters of tool `name` + `description` | 139,502 |
| rough token estimate (`chars ÷ 3.5`) | **≈ 40,000 tokens** |

dsh-rea-toggle README · The problem：That is the *descriptions alone* — the full JSON Schemas add more, partly reduced by REA's own `REA_MCP_INPUT_SCHEMA_PROFILE=compact`. Your tokenizer, host version and schema profile will change the number; the order of magnitude will not.

For a reverse-engineering session, 40k tokens of tool surface is a bargain. For "help me write a video script", it is dead weight you cannot switch off.

dsh-rea-toggle README · Why REA does not ship this switch itself：Verified against `rea-agents@6.8.0`:

```console
$ rea mcp --help
rea mcp — Register as MCP server

Usage: rea mcp <command>

`add` and `doctor`. **No `remove`, no `disable`, no enable, no tool filter.** `rea mcp add --agent <claude-code|cursor|…>` only *writes* a config line into a client; nothing in REA can unregister its tools at runtime.
section: Why REA does not ship this switch itself

text:
dsh-rea-toggle README · Why REA does not ship this switch itself：That is structural, not an oversight: **an MCP server cannot unregister itself.** The tools exist because the host launched the server and asked for `tools/list`. Only the host can decide not to.

And on the host side, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`'s config surface has no inclusion filter either:

```
transport · serverName · command · args · env · cwd
toolCallTimeoutMs · failOnStartupError · maxInstructionBytes · reconnect
```
section: Why REA does not ship this switch itself

text: dsh-rea-toggle README · Why REA does not ship this switch itself：So the switch has to live in the loader patch — the one place that can say "do not start this row". That is exactly the one flag this plugin owns.
section: Why REA does not ship this switch itself

text:
dsh-rea-toggle README · What it does：It flips **one key** — `disabled` — on **one row** of your profile patch:

```yaml

dsh-rea-toggle README · <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml：- insert:
    - id: rea-mcp
      disabled: true          # ← this, and nothing else
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client"
      config: { … }
```

- Reads nothing for writing except that file.
- Writes nothing except that flag.
- Never touches `~/.dsh/plugins/rea-agents`, never uninstalls REA, never patches a binary.
- Reversible by clicking again.

| Node.js | ≥ 20 |
| An `mcp-client` row that launches REA | e.g. `id: rea-mcp` |

You need REA already working in DSH. This plugin does not install REA.

|---|---|

```yaml

Set `targetId` if your REA row is not called `rea-mcp`. Multi-server setups: one plugin row per target, each with a distinct `routePrefix`.

dsh-rea-toggle README · What this plugin is not：- Not a REA wrapper, fork, or patch. It never reads REA's code or version.
- Not a tool filter. `dsh-mcp-client` has no inclusion field, so "keep only these 20 tools" is not possible here — it is all 229 or none.
- Not an installer. It will not fetch REA, Ghidra, JDK, adb or JADX.
- Not a security bypass. It toggles a YAML key you already own.
- Not a token counter. The ≈40k figure is an estimate from REA's own `tools/list`; measure your own if it matters.

dsh-rea-toggle README · Security：The two endpoints accept `GET /status` and `POST /set` only, on the harness's own loopback web port, and reject a `POST` whose `Origin` host does not match the request `Host`. Body is capped at 64 KiB. Nothing is exposed to the network.

The plugin writes to exactly one path — `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` — and only to the `disabled` line inside the target row.

dsh-rea-toggle README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| No chip in the composer | client half not scanned at boot | fully quit the harness (tray too), start again |
| Chip shows `REA ?` | endpoint unreachable or row missing | hover for the message; check `/rea-toggle/status` |
| `row "rea-mcp" not found` | your REA row has another id | set `config.targetId` |
| Toggled OFF, tools still there | tool registration happens at boot | restart the harness |
| Changing `disabled` does nothing | no `mcp-client` row launches REA on this profile | this switch is not the problem; check your REA install |
